newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq June short interest 1.56bln shrs vs 1.53bln.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq June short interest 1.56bln shrs vs 1.53bln.

text.p: NASDAQ said Tuesday short interest totaled 1.56 billion shares in mid-June, compared with 1.53 billion shares in May.
The short interest represent 2.91 days of NASDAQ's average daily trading volume for the period, compared with 2.76 days in May, the satement said.
NASDAQ measured short interest in 4,108 National Market securities for June and in 4,099 shares for May.

Short interest in 1,465 NASDAQ SmallCap Market securities totaled 52.0 million shares in mid-June, compared with 50.1 shares in 1,432 issues in May. This represented 1.10 days of average daily volume, compared with an average of 1.23 days in May, NASDAQ said.

Short interest in all NASDAQ securities (5,573) totaled 1.61 billion shares, or 2.76 average daily volume, for June, compared with 1.58 billion shares in 5,531 issues, or an average 2.66 days of trading, for May.
The figures include all short interest positions reported May 16 through June 10 and settled as of June 13, NASDAQ said.
